items.text: A US official told NewsNation that American forces are not conducting any attacks near Jask, following reports of an explosion sound. The Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting had reported hearing an explosion from the direction of the Strait of Hormuz in Jask on Wednesday evening.

A worker in the Khazra Industrial Town in Kerman province was injured while working with an industrial machine. The accident occurred due to a lack of safety and poor working conditions. The report was published by Harana News Agency.

An informed source told Iran International that the health and humanitarian situation in Qom Central Prison is dire. Most prisoners have contracted influenza and COVID-19. The prison environment is heavily contaminated and the prisoners' daily food rations are insufficient.

Mohammed bin Zayed, the UAE president, warned Netanyahu about Yahya Sinwar's plan to attack Israel one week before October 7. Netanyahu denied the warning and said no such call took place. UAE officials neither confirmed nor denied the report.

Ismail Baqaei, the Foreign Ministry spokesperson, said that referring Iran's nuclear case to the UN Security Council is irrelevant because Iran has not violated any commitments. He attributed the issues raised in the Board of Governors resolution to attacks by the US and Israel. Baqaei described Japan and Saudi Arabia's positive vote on the resolution as ineffective.
Three defendants in Lavasanat, Shemiranat County, were sentenced to provide stationery for underprivileged students and supply equipment for eight classrooms instead of prison sentences.

A citizen says they have to buy various medicines every month but the prices have become very expensive. They are worried they might not be able to afford their medicines anymore. They also attribute the rise in medicine prices to the increase in gasoline prices.
A 38-year-old man was killed in Qom by one of his friends and colleagues. The accused claimed that after learning about the victim's relationship and harassment of his wife, he committed the murder.

Donald Trump stated that the war with Iran will end immediately after the 2026 US elections. He said he is no longer seeking an agreement with the Islamic Republic and that negotiations might occur but are not the current focus. Trump also mentioned working on matters beyond the nuclear deal, involving new issues.

A video from the evening of September 8 shows that a government gathering in one of the squares in Qom was sparse. The seats at this gathering were mostly empty. This video was received by Iran International.

On Wednesday, 18 Shahrivar, gas line six workers in Ahvaz and Bidboland went on strike for the third consecutive day. Esmail Bakhshi protested in front of the Haft Tappeh Sugarcane Complex. Additionally, SnappBox drivers held protests in Semnan and Arak.

Sardar Azmoun has been re-invited to the Iranian national football team after recent controversies and government criticisms. He is expected to participate in the upcoming FIFA international window and preparations for the Asian Cup. This return comes after Azmoun distanced himself from the national team and had his assets seized.
Milad Morvati, a law student at Azad University of Mahabad, was released from the city's prison after posting bail. This event occurred today. More information is available from Harana News Agency.
Fouad Fathi, a labor activist, was released from Evin Prison after serving his sentence. This event occurred today. More information is available from Harana News Agency.

Pakistan has conveyed Saudi Arabia's message to Tehran, asking Iran to use its influence to stop Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. Tehran responded that it does not control the Houthis. Sources also said that last week Tehran asked the Houthis to attack Saudi Arabia and promised financial and military support.

A citizen stated in a video that last year he started a business by selling his gold but has not recovered his initial capital until now. He shared this issue on social media. This complaint points to financial problems in the business.

Meir Javdanfar said there are signs of increasing disagreement between Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu. Their relations remain good, but Trump's stance on the upcoming Israeli elections is important. Among Trump's advisors, there is also disagreement on how to deal with Netanyahu.

Farzin Nadimi stated that conventional bombs may not be sufficient to completely destroy the underground facilities of Kuh-e Kalang-Gazla. The Pentagon is considering developing more advanced penetrator weapons and new operational scenarios. Additionally, locations near the Strait of Hormuz hold greater military significance than Khark Island.

A citizen installed a street sign named Mahsa Amini Street in eastern Seyyed Ghotb Street, Piranshahr, on the eve of the anniversary of Mahsa Zeina Amini's death. This act is shown in a video received by Iran International.

Al Nassr football team defeated Abha 2-1 in the sixth week of the Saudi Professional League. Cristiano Ronaldo scored the first goal in the 22nd minute, bringing his career goal tally to 979. With this win, Al Nassr achieved their fifth victory and tied in points with Al Hilal and Al Qadsiah.

The head of the Iranian Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Association warned about a 59% increase in liver cancer over the past 10 years. Shahram Kordasti attributed this rise to poor nutrition, fatty liver, and weak prevention programs. He emphasized the importance of prevention and the challenges in accessing medical services.
Messages have been received about an explosion in Qeshm. No further details have been provided. These messages have been made public.

The mother of Setareh Rafiei lit a candle in the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" in memory of her daughter. Setareh Rafiei, 19 years old, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Narmak, Tehran. Her mother stated that she neither forgives nor forgets.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, said that the Islamic Republic has not received assistance to change the war conditions. He added that the Islamic Republic attacks US Navy ships but has lost five of its oil tankers in response. Rubio emphasized that the US will continue to economically suffocate the Islamic Republic.

Alireza Salimi stated that leaving the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) could be one of Iran's options to respond to the IAEA Board of Governors resolution. He described the resolution as political and hostile and said Iran has not benefited from the treaty's rights. Salimi predicted that actions related to the resolution would face a veto due to Russia and China's membership in the Security Council.

The Yemeni Armed Forces Media Center released a video showing clashes between Saudi-backed government forces and Houthi forces. The exact time and location of the video recording have not been confirmed. Clashes have intensified recently, and Yemeni government forces have launched a multi-front attack on Houthi-controlled areas.

The Yemeni Armed Forces Media Center released a video showing clashes between Saudi-backed government forces and Houthi forces near Al Hazm. These clashes have intensified in recent months, raising concerns about a return to a broader war. Yemeni government forces have launched a multi-front attack to reclaim areas controlled by the Houthis.

Rouhollah Najabat stated that the Islamic Republic will accelerate the technical development of its nuclear program in response to the IAEA Board of Governors resolution. He emphasized that Iran will not give any concessions and will respond more firmly. Najabat also described the resolution as political and held Western countries responsible for any potential tensions.

Esmaeil Baqaei, spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, denied Marco Rubio's claims that the Houthis are proxies of Iran, stating that the Houthis are an independent actor who take their own decisions. This response came after Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that injured at least 73 people. It was also reported that Saudi Arabia sent a message through Pakistan asking Iran to intervene to stop the Houthi attacks.

Several explosions were heard in the coastal areas of Qeshm, Sirik, and Minab in the early hours of Thursday, September 19. The Hormozgan governorate stated that the sounds came from the sea, and no reports about the cause or damage have been released yet. The explosions were strong enough to shake buildings and windows.

Palmer Luckey, founder of Anduril, stated that the Dive-DL drone is designed so that losing it in operations does not create a security problem. The drone is made for extremely dangerous environments and its loss is acceptable. He added that the device provided significant operational value for months before falling into enemy hands.

A program with Kambiz Hosseini about unprecedented sanctions on Iranian aviation has been released. The program discusses the possibility of all flights being canceled. The main topic is the sanctions and their impact on Iran's flights.

Railway workers protested in front of the Ministry of Roads and Urban Development in Tehran. They protested against repression and poor living conditions, chanting slogans against the minister. They threatened to strike if their problems were not resolved.

The defense company Covenant, supported by Peter Thiel, has started producing long-range, low-cost cruise missiles. The company designed the 'Anthem' missile with heavy payload capacity and has conducted about 200 test flights. Covenant has received orders worth $150 million, with deliveries starting in 2027.

Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for the IRGC, dismissed Benjamin Netanyahu's threats and considered Israel too small to carry out threats against Iran. Netanyahu had stated that Israel is ready to act against Iran if necessary. He also said that they must finish what they started with the Islamic Republic.

Chris Wright, the US Energy Secretary, announced that more contracts with oil companies in Venezuela will be announced soon. He previously said these contracts would more than double Venezuela's oil production. Increased investment in Venezuela's energy sector could significantly boost oil production capacity.

Reuters reported that Iran has obtained a US Navy underwater drone. The drone, an older Dive-LD model, was found by Iranian forces after a technical failure. Iran may reverse-engineer parts of the drone, but this is unlikely to provide a decisive military advantage for Tehran.

Arash Aramesh, a lawyer and security expert, said the Trump administration has not yet made a final decision on its ultimate strategy towards the Islamic Republic. He added that the US is currently between three options: escalating the war, continuing the status quo, or moving towards a deal, and it is not yet clear which path it will choose. He also said the US has the military capability to conduct limited ground operations, including on some strategic Iranian islands, but the decision depends more on political will than military factors.

The Iranian Transitional Justice Committee warned the perpetrators and commanders of protester executions that these crimes will be pursued without leniency. Afshin Elyan emphasized the need to document executions and human rights violations, stating those involved will face legal responsibility. He urged citizens to securely keep documents related to executions for use in transitional justice and international legal proceedings.

Hadad Adel said that the Islamic Republic's work on women's dress has become more difficult and that the enemy promotes a Western lifestyle. He mentioned the failure of policies that do not recognize women as having the right to choose. This topic is discussed in a program hosted by Kambiz Hosseini.

Hadad Adel stated that the Islamic Republic has failed regarding women's dress code. He said policies that ignore women's right to choose have caused this failure. He also emphasized that people have not been influenced by enemy infiltration but have moved beyond the government's policies.

The Center for Strategic and International Studies reported that satellite images show increased construction activities in the underground complex of Kuh-e Kalang Gazla near the Natanz nuclear facility in 2026. Activities have shifted from excavation to internal construction and tunnel entrance reinforcement. The center neither confirmed nor denied claims of centrifuge transfers to this complex.

The Transitional Justice Committee, chaired by Shirin Ebadi, warned the commanders and executors of protesters' executions that each of them will be held accountable. The committee stated that no leniency will be shown and all legal tools will be used for prosecution and punishment. It also emphasized that each execution increases criminal responsibility and these crimes will not be forgotten.

The Islamic Republic used missiles equipped with electro-optical guidance systems for the first time in attacks on US warships on Wednesday, September 8. CENTCOM confirmed the missile attacks but stated that no ships were hit. The Revolutionary Guards claimed to have targeted two American vessels and several tankers and ships.

The Wall Street Journal, quoting American officials, reported that senior White House advisors have discussed with President Donald Trump the possibility of the war with the Islamic Republic continuing until the end of his presidency and even beyond January 2029. According to the report, JD Vance, the US Vice President, Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, and other officials discussed the possibility of Tehran continuing its resistance against military siege and pressures. This assessment differs from Trump's public statements, where he said the war would end "immediately" after the November midterm elections.

The Saudi-led coalition announced that the Houthis targeted the cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Jazan with ballistic missiles and drones on Wednesday, September 8. The coalition spokesperson stated that their response to these attacks will be within the framework of the right to self-defense. Additionally, Saudi Arabia has asked Iran through Pakistan to influence the Houthis to stop the attacks, but Tehran said it does not control the Houthis.

Reuters, citing a CBS reporter, reported that several US military aircraft were damaged in nighttime attacks on the Al-Salti airbase in Jordan. An A-10 Thunderbolt lost one of its wings, and about eight F-15s sustained minor damage but returned to service. The Islamic Republic announced that it had targeted the base with ballistic missiles.

Donald Trump said at a Republican gathering in Dallas that the war with the Islamic Republic will end shortly after the November 3 midterm elections. He added that Tehran wants a deal with the Democrats.

Donald Trump stated that the decision to attack Iran's nuclear facilities was made after receiving reports about Tehran's proximity to nuclear weapons. He said some officials wanted to delay the attack, but he opposed it. Trump also discussed the bomber operation and the possibility of attacking Kuh-e Kolang Gazla.

Donald Trump warned the Islamic Republic about activities at Kuh-e Kalanq Gezla and said Iran should not have nuclear weapons. He emphasized that Iran cannot have nuclear weapons and criticized past efforts to negotiate with Iran. Trump also mentioned the possibility of targeting these facilities.
Trump reported observing 'movements' in Mount Klang-gazla and warned the Islamic Republic of Iran: 'I advise Iran not to play smart, because we will have to attack it very hard.'

Shayan Samiei said Trump has left the door open for negotiations with the Islamic Republic but considers the previous agreement ended. He added that Trump sends a message to the Iranian people that they are separate from the government.

Shahram Kholdi referred to Donald Trump's statements about the attack on the Kuh-e-Kalang facility and said that if the attack does not lead to the complete destruction of the facility, the Islamic Republic will move towards militarizing its nuclear program.

Sahar Khodayari, an Esteghlal fan, self-immolated in protest against a six-month prison sentence for attempting to enter Azadi Stadium and died on September 9, 2019. She had been accused of various charges including public indecency. Her death received widespread international attention.

Marzieh Hosseini, a reporter for Iran International, has reported on Donald Trump's speech at the Republican gathering. She mentioned the possibility of another US attack on the Kooh Kalang facilities. She also examined the connection between the war with the Islamic Republic and the US midterm elections.

The "Jan Faday Iran" exercise will be held on September 17 with the participation of Basij forces, the Revolutionary Guards, and police. The commander of Tehran's Revolutionary Guards stated that this exercise demonstrates the readiness and determination of the Iranian nation. Its purpose is declared to confront the enemies.

Roghayeh Rezaei reported an increase in the prices of menstrual hygiene products. She stated that the Islamic Republic imposes restrictions on women's bodies alongside pro-natalist policies. Additionally, necessary support for women's healthcare is not provided.

Lamine Yamal became the youngest captain in Barcelona's history at 19 years and 58 days old. He received the captain's armband from Rafinha during the match against Feyenoord and scored six minutes later. The previous record was held by Bojan Krkic, who became captain at 20 years and 56 days old.

The Iranian national basketball team lost 59-53 to Qatar in their first game at the Nagoya Asian Games. The first quarter ended tied at 10-10, and Qatar led 31-21 at halftime. Iran will next face Taiwan and Jordan in the group stage.

Mohammad Sadegh Motamedian, the governor of Tehran, called for the return of schools that have been taken over by other organizations. He emphasized that these educational spaces must be returned to the Ministry of Education before the start of the school year. The governor did not specify which organizations are involved.

A report on the economic difficulties faced by people in Iran, including reduced wages, rising prices of goods and services, and issues caused by power outages and financial restrictions. A threefold increase in electricity bills in Tehran and educational problems in Khorramabad were also mentioned. These conditions have led to depression and dissatisfaction among the people.

Mohammad Qaedi, an international relations lecturer, said Pakistan is mediating between Saudi Arabia and the Islamic Republic. Saudi Arabia still prefers diplomacy over military confrontation. However, continued Houthi attacks and heavy casualties may force Saudi Arabia to react.

The Islamic Republic of Iran has used a barter-like mechanism to bypass oil sanctions and purchase goods from China. This mechanism has been active since 2021 and was initially used to procure medicine and COVID-19 vaccines. It has also been used to buy cars, communication equipment, and air defense systems.
Mohammad Amin Salami's brother commemorated his brother and other martyrs by lighting a candle. He said their names will remain immortal throughout history.

A 35-year-old person stated that due to difficult economic conditions and life pressures, they get angry faster than before, and society has become very angry and hostile. They mentioned an increase in conflicts and a decrease in people's tolerance. This situation has caused depression and psychological pressure among the people.

Hossein Akbari, deputy of natural environment at Isfahan Environmental Protection, attributed the mass death of fish in the Zayandeh Rud riverbed to the water flow cut. He stated that the regional water company must take responsibility for this incident. After the water flow was cut on September 6, thousands of fish died and some were trapped in remaining pools.

On Wednesday, 18 Shahrivar, several users of Cryptoland exchange protested in front of Tehran Prosecutor's Office due to lack of response to their demands. The protesters held banners and chanted slogans demanding investigation of the case and recovery of their assets. The protest was met with police intervention and some arrests.

The sister of Ahmad Khosravani posted a video expressing her pain and longing eight months after his death. Ahmad Khosravani, a student at Sharif University of Technology and a basketball player, was shot dead on the evening of January 8, 2026. He was the champion of the Tehran 3x3 basketball tournament and the best player in the Tehran league in 2025.

Rouhollah Rahimpour said Trump's remarks about 'Kuh-e Kalanq' indicate that Washington believes the Islamic Republic is rebuilding part of its nuclear capacity. He added that moving activities underground does not protect them from military pressure.

Mohammad Şimşek, Turkey's Minister of Finance, stated that Ankara has taken note of the recent US sanctions related to economic activities with Iran. He emphasized that Turkish companies and financial institutions must fully comply with domestic laws. These remarks were made in an interview with Narges Horkhsh.

Babak Negahdari, head of the Parliament Research Center, stated that public preference for ceasefire and negotiation dropped from 60% between May and July to 45% between July and September. The inclination towards confrontation and preemptive attack on the US increased by 10 percentage points. Details of the survey method and participant numbers were not disclosed.

The mother of Maedeh Moradi Kian lit a candle on her daughter's grave and said she will live until she avenges her. Maedeh Moradi Kian, 22 years old, was killed by gunfire from officers on January 9 in Qaemshahr. This video was published on social media.

A cafe in Borujen was closed due to producing and sharing an advertising clip on social media. The cafe operators were arrested. Since the beginning of this year, 20 social media activists in this city have faced legal prosecution.

Asal Mansouri was killed by Khamenei's forces with live ammunition during the protests on January 9 in Tehran. This event remains in the memory of the Iranian people. Her memory will be preserved as a guiding light for freedom seekers.

Ali Parvin commented on Khodadad Azizi's audio file, saying Khodadad should be careful and hopes the issue will be resolved. He also said that Persepolis started the league well and has had an acceptable performance so far. Parvin believes if the team continues this way, they will become champions.

The identity of Lefteh Heydari, one of the detained Sunni citizens in Ahvaz, has been confirmed. This individual was arrested along with at least nine others on Friday, September 4. The identities of several other detainees had been confirmed earlier.

Hamidreza Omidi, CEO of the Hijab Activists Association, stated that the price of black chadors is highly dependent on the dollar rate. He added that producers have lost about 10% of their capital in the past 48 hours. Selling the product is not profitable for them.

Maryam Azimi, an Iranian Apple engineer, introduced the "Apple Reference Image" technology at the global unveiling of the iPhone 18 Pro. This technology enables verification of photo authenticity and detection of edited or AI-generated images. Her presence attracted attention due to her role in technology development and her public stance against the Islamic Republic.

The mother of Ali Ghorbani Toraghi, a protester killed in December 2025, honored her son's memory by joining the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." She said, "I neither forgive nor forget." This video was published on social media.

A number of active and retired railway workers gathered in front of the Ministry of Roads and Urban Development in Tehran. They protested against economic conditions and their poor livelihood situation. They demanded attention to their demands.

The National Resistance media in Yemen announced that it obtained maps showing the IRGC's plan for advancing and controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait. These maps were found on the laptop of a captured Houthi commander. The images show four stages of advancement towards the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the city of Hodeidah.

After missile launches by the IRGC at US bases in Jordan and interception of some in Israeli airspace, the Israeli army has raised its alert level. Benjamin Netanyahu and Yisrael Katz warned that Israel will not allow the reconstruction of Iran's missile and nuclear capabilities. An interview was conducted with Babak Es-haqi, a journalist from Iran International.

Pakistan has sent a message to Tehran asking the Islamic Republic to control the Houthis. On Tuesday, the Houthis attacked a Saudi Arabian airbase and oil infrastructure. These attacks injured 73 people.

The father of Amirhossein Sheikhbu, a protester killed in December 2025, joined the "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" campaign by visiting his son's grave. He said each candle reminds of thousands of lives, names, memories, and absences.

The Russian Caravanserai, a historic building in Sabzevar, was demolished by the municipality. The building was recognized as a historic site in official maps and efforts were made to register it nationally. The demolition is being pursued through judicial authorities.

The Iranian Football League Organization announced that four matches of the seventh week of the Premier League have been postponed due to the presence of players in the national youth team camp. The matches Zob Ahan - Sepahan, Kheybar - Persepolis, Malavan - Foolad, and Fajr Sepasi - Aluminium will not be held. The new dates for these matches will be announced later.

Ali Hossein Ghazizadeh stated that the Islamic Republic has deployed military and security forces in schools. This move is to use schools as a protective layer for their forces. There are also reports of attempts to permanently seize some schools.

People report becoming angry more quickly and having less tolerance than before. The poor economic and social conditions have negatively affected people's mental health. Additionally, the price of Depakine, a medication for nerves, has significantly increased.

A protest rally was held in Rome in support of Taraneh and Romina Rahimi, two 19-year-old Iranian sisters sentenced to death and 25 years in prison. Representatives from the 'Moderates' party and other members of the Italian parliament called for an end to executions and torture of political prisoners in Iran. The main slogan of the rally was 'Freedom is not hanged.'

Military sources from the Yemeni government say that the Houthis, supported by the Islamic Republic, are trying to strengthen their position near the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait. Reuters, citing four military sources, reported that the Houthis have nearly full control over coastal areas including the ports of Mocha and Dhubab. More details were provided by an Iran International reporter.

A sick citizen told Iran International in a video that the pharmacy official said the increase in gasoline prices caused the rise in drug prices. This issue was mentioned as the reason for the increased cost of medicine. This statement was made by the pharmacy official.

Hossein Afrasiab, a prisoner in Dastgerd prison in Isfahan, was sentenced to three years, nine months, and twenty days of imprisonment. His initial sentence was five years and one month, which was reduced in the final ruling. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

TankerTrackers reported that ship-to-ship transfers of crude oil in the Gulf of Oman reached 7.15 million barrels per day over the past 14 days, a 56 percent increase from the previous month. The increase comes amid ongoing concerns about shipping security in the Strait of Hormuz.

The mother of Soda Akramifard, a protester killed in December 2025, joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." She urged others to light candles in memory of the eternal names. This video was shared on social media.

The US has stated that it targeted 10 tankers linked to the Islamic Republic in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman in three waves. Among these tankers, the sinking of two vessels named Kaylo and Risko has been confirmed.

One of the protesters injured by a bullet in December is still unable to walk. This person has undergone 23 surgeries and recovery of mobility may take at least another year. The treatment costs and security concerns have put significant pressure on him and his family.

Mehdi Tartaar, Persepolis coach, announced the unilateral cancellation of their match against Kheybar by the league organization without coordination. He stated that the club had not requested the cancellation and that the decision caused shock and dissatisfaction. Tartaar emphasized that his team opposes the cancellation and wants the match to be played.

A citizen stated in a video that they paid 1,100,000 tomans for several dairy products. He held the Islamic Republic responsible for this situation. This issue has raised concerns about rising prices.

A craftsman criticized the downturn of his industrial unit in a video published on social media. He said that in the past 47 years, the economic and business situation has never been this bad. This video reflects economic concerns.

Majid Saeedi, a photojournalist, was arrested on Wednesday, 18 Shahrivar, at his home in Tehran. His family is unaware of the reasons for his arrest and his location. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Maryam Azimi Hashemi, a member of Apple's camera technology team, received her bachelor's degree from Ferdowsi University of Mashhad. She continued her master's and doctoral studies at the University of British Columbia. In 2023, Azimi introduced new portrait photography features for the iPhone 15.

The G7 parliamentary meeting will start on Thursday in Paris. The heads of parliaments of G7 member countries, along with the presidents of the European and Ukrainian parliaments, will meet and discuss. This report is by Sajedeh Sharifi from Iran International.
A citizen stated in a video that they paid 490,000 tomans for a melon and two kilograms of potatoes. This indicates a price increase for these products. The video was published by Iran International.

Israel Katz, Israel's defense minister, wished Iranian Jews a good and safe year and called for Tehran to be freed from oppression. He warned that if the Islamic Republic attacks Israel, a strong response will target sites in Iran. Katz stated such an attack would set Iran back decades and destabilize the regime.

Ukraine targeted eight Russian infrastructure facilities in the past 24 hours, including an oil refinery in Yamalo-Nenets and a seaport in Dagestan. Videos have been released showing an attack on a port in Makhachkala, Dagestan. Ukraine had previously targeted an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea.

A video published on social media shows a shopkeeper expressing fatigue over the continuous decline of the Iranian rial against the US dollar and rising product prices. The video reflects public concerns about the economic situation. The shopkeeper protested against these conditions.

Videos and reports indicate that thousands of fish, including sardines and carp, have died due to the repeated closure of the Zayandeh Rud river flow in Isfahan. In addition, gatherings of insects and animals such as crows have been observed along the river path.

A video shows citizens helping a delivery rider financially after his motorcycle caught fire. A card number was shared for donations. The funds aim to buy a replacement motorcycle for the damaged rider.

Israel's Defense Minister Yisrael Katz stated that any attack by the Islamic Republic on Israel will be met with a powerful response that may include Iran's main energy facilities. He said this strike could set Iran back decades and further destabilize the Islamic Republic's government. The Israeli army is on alert and ready to carry out this mission.

Ali Zarei, a protester sentenced to death, has requested help from human rights activists and the United Nations in an audio file. He was convicted of corruption on earth and political activities against the regime. The sentence was issued by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court.

Reuters reported that Iran is importing billions of dollars worth of goods, including military equipment, from China by using a barter-like mechanism to bypass sanctions. This financial mechanism exchanges Iranian oil for credit to import from China. Iran has also used this method to purchase medicine, vehicles, and communication equipment.
Amid rising tensions in the Middle East, Brent crude oil price crossed $102 on Thursday, showing about a 1% increase from the previous day and about 8% from the beginning of the month.
The price of the dollar in Tehran's market reached 235,700 tomans on Thursday, September 10. The daily increase in currency prices continued. This report was published by Vahid Online.

Mahdi Khalili, a 22-year-old lifeguard and swimming coach, was shot dead on the evening of January 8, 2026, in Vavan, Islamshahr. His mother expressed her grief and longing for her son in a video. The incident was caused by the suppression forces of the Islamic Republic.

The head of the National Center for Air and Climate Change announced that 63% of Tehran's internet taxis are over 10 years old, and 41% are over 15 years old. Vehicles older than 10 years account for about 64% of the total mileage of the fleet. Approximately 30,000 high-mileage vehicles over 10 years old are prioritized for renewal.

Alireza Salimi, a member of the parliament's board, called the Cabinet's opposition to the National Security Commission's report on the foreign infiltration countermeasure plan illegal. He emphasized that the plan belongs to the parliament and the government cannot act independently of it. Salimi also urged the government to focus on economic issues instead of political behavior.

A father sent a voice message to Iran International discussing the high cost of school supplies for his daughter. He mentioned financial difficulties related to this issue. This has raised concerns about the expenses of education.

The Instagram page of Samaneh Assaran, mother of Kiawash Mirghasemi, was blocked and taken over by Iranian security agencies. All previous posts were deleted, leaving only one judicial post on the page. This action follows ongoing pressures and arrests of families seeking justice.

The French Football Federation announced that it will not support Gianni Infantino's candidacy for re-election as FIFA president. This decision was made unanimously by the federation's executive committee. The reasons include concerns about the management of share sales related to the World Cup and FIFA's governance.

The father of Mohsen Abbasi, a victim of the National Iranian Revolution, said at his son's grave that young people fear the difficulties of life, not death. He expressed regret. This video was shared on social media.

British police arrested a 42-year-old woman and a 60-year-old man on charges of aiding the security institutions of the Islamic Republic. The arrests took place on September 9 in London. Police stated that these arrests are not related to attacks on locations associated with Jewish communities and Iranian opponents of the Islamic Republic.

Arsalan Yazdani, a Bahá'í citizen and political prisoner, has been transferred from Tehran's main prison to an unknown location. His family has expressed concern due to lack of information about his condition. The transfer occurred without prior notice and no contact has been made with his family.

A video shows the wife of Mohsen Rashidi Khan Abadi, a protester killed in December 2025, joining the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." She lit a candle in memory of the "Eternal Names of the Homeland." The video was shared on social media.

Iran International conducted an Instagram survey about the psychological effects of the January killings and ongoing war. About 38,000 people participated, with 94% saying their anger is triggered more quickly than before. Seba Heydarkhani explained the reasons for participants' anger.

A citizen sent a video showing that a call to join the Karbala Infantry Brigade is being distributed among teenagers in the street. The Karbala Infantry Brigade is one of the ground forces bases of the IRGC. This base operates in southwestern Iran.

Houshang Sohrabi, the 45-year-old brother of missing Yasin Sohrabi, died of cardiac arrest due to psychological pressure on September 3. The mother is reported to be in poor mental condition after his death. More details were provided by Farnoush Faraji.

Meysam Zolqi, head of the Construction Workers' Association, criticized the lack of sufficient supervision over old and non-standard scaffolding. He stated that a significant portion of fatal accidents is caused by the use of old and unsafe scaffolding. He called for banning the use of worn-out scaffolding and increasing field inspections.

The mother of Parnian Dabiri, a protester killed in December 2025, joined the "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" campaign. She said her daughter lives on in her heart and mind and expressed pride in her. The mother described Parnian as a calm and brave girl whose life was taken.

Singapore's Internal Security Department warned in its annual terrorism threat assessment about the expansion of the IRGC and resistance axis groups' activities into Southeast Asia. The agency stated that the IRGC and its proxy groups increase the risk of attacks beyond the Middle East. Mehdi Beigi from Iran International explains details of the security report.

The mother of Mohammadreza Ahangar, a protester killed in December 2025, joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." In a video, she said that heroes never die. This video was shared on social media.

Rafael Grossi, the Director General of the IAEA, reported recent movements at the Kuh-e-Kalang Gezla site. The agency has not yet inspected inside the tunnels of this site. Donald Trump also mentioned activity at this site and issued a warning.

The sister of Hamidreza Hosseinipour, a protester killed in December 2025, joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." In the video, she said, "We neither forgive nor forget." This video was published on social media.

The head of the Health Commission of the Parliament announced that drug prices in the country have increased 5 to 6 times. Medical equipment prices have also risen significantly. He warned that continuing this trend will put more pressure on people and patients.

A citizen criticized the high prices of nuts and dried fruits in a video sent to Iran International. He said he paid over half a million tomans for two handfuls of almonds. This indicates a significant increase in prices.

Detainees of the Iranian National Revolution in December 1404 have faced threats and beatings by common criminals in Tehran's central prison. In one incident, five prisoners attacked a detainee and forced him to give consent. This information was reported to Iran International by an informed source.

British police arrested two individuals suspected of crimes related to Iran and violating the UK's national security law. The arrests took place in London during investigations related to Iran. The police emphasized that these investigations are not connected to recent incidents involving Jewish and Iranian communities in the UK.

Security forces raided the home of Kiawash Mirghasemi's family a month ago and arrested his mother, Samaneh Assaran. Her Instagram page has been taken down and is now controlled by security agencies. All previous posts were deleted, leaving only one post by judicial order.

Rafael Grossi stated that the International Atomic Energy Agency has observed construction activities at the Pickaxe Mountain site in southern Iran's enrichment complex based on satellite images. Inspectors have not yet been able to inspect inside the deep tunnels of this site. Donald Trump also warned against any actions by Iran at this site.

Yahya Saree, the spokesperson for the Houthis, stated that their current operation is limited and defensive in nature. He said the operation will stop once attacks on Yemen end and the blockade is lifted. He also confirmed that shipping routes in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab Strait remain safe and uninterrupted.

The UN Security Council is holding a public meeting to review the activities of the sanctions committee under Resolution 1737 concerning Iran. This meeting takes place one day after the IAEA Board of Governors adopted a resolution. The resolution requests the IAEA Director General to report Iran's nuclear file to the Security Council and the General Assembly.

CENTCOM announced that the US military has forced 96 commercial ships to change course by Thursday. Additionally, more than 50 ships carrying humanitarian aid were allowed to pass. This operation took place in the blockade of Iranian ports.

An army aviation soldier reports insufficient salary and fear of execution if protesting. A judiciary employee is ill but cannot afford treatment. Economic difficulties include drug shortages and inability to pay student tuition.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the Central Bank governor, called the US sanctions and economic pressure a miscalculation. He said these pressures increase the costs for the US. Hemmati added that US actions have mainly involved income and trade restrictions and temporary impacts on markets.

The 51st Toronto International Film Festival began with the screening of 293 films from around the world. Iranian filmmakers are prominently present in the main, documentary, short film, and experimental film sections. This report is by Mahsa Mortazavi from Iran International.

Reuters reported that the rapid advance of the Houthis along Yemen's Red Sea coast was directly led by the IRGC. The capture of the port city of Mocha has strengthened Houthi control over the Bab al-Mandab Strait. Military sources say Abdulreza Shahlaei, a commander of the IRGC Quds Force, is leading this operation.

Some contract workers at Iranshahr Municipality reported three months of unpaid wages and insurance. The head of the Kurdistan Islamic Labor Council also criticized the non-payment of overtime for workers in some units of the province.

Pouya Bakhtiari's father congratulated his son's birthday from prison in an audio message. He mentioned that he has been deprived of visiting his son's grave for years. Pouya Bakhtiari was one of the victims of the nationwide protests in 2022.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the Islamic Republic has resumed ballistic missile production in underground facilities. These missiles are assembled using stored parts and in smaller quantities. Liquid-fueled missile assembly must be done shortly before launch.

Esteghlal football team defeated Paykan in the seventh week of the Premier League with a goal by Yaser Asani. Asani's goal was scored in the 76th minute from a penalty. This victory ended Esteghlal's consecutive draws.

The sister of Amir Mohammad Shahkarami posted a video stating that on September 8 she went to the place where her brother was present during the December protests. In the video, she raised Amir Mohammad's photo and shouted his name. Amir Mohammad Shahkarami, a 14-year-old teenager, was arrested on December 8 during the protests in Qods city, and his body was returned to the family 60 days later.
